editorialNotes: Hitbox and hurtbox are editorial terms for different roles. Our geometry computes distance from blade segment to a sphere, verifies the effect of radius, uses a second synchronized camera and changes only the enabled frame range. Gameplay overlays must never claim invisible commercial game values.
